title: \((1,2)\)-bosonic-fermionic coinvariant ring：Conjecture 3.2 的首个开放维数 \(n=5\)
summary: Conjecture 3.2 is certified at n=5 over every characteristic-zero field: the quotient dimension and candidate rank are both 1920. A uniform 4n invariant-generator proof, the exact QQ/Singular normal-form certificate, an exact QQ/FLINT reconstruction, and a frozen no-import QQ/Singular reconstruction of all 396 blocks agree. The general-n conjecture and an initial-ideal recurrence remain open.
author: Zijian Zeng
affiliation: Institute of Computer Science and Digital Innovation, UCSI University, Kuala Lumpur, 56000, MALAYSIA
